picks.title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
picks.why_it_matters: Strong founder pedigree (ex-Google security) attacking a rapidly expanding threat surface as AI-powered attacks proliferate—signals a defensible, growing market for AI-native cybersecurity startups.

picks.title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
picks.why_it_matters: Potential restrictions on open-weight models like DeepSeek could fundamentally reshape the cost structure and competitive dynamics for AI-native startups, making this a critical regulatory signal to monitor.

picks.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
picks.why_it_matters: As foundation models commoditize, orchestration and routing layers emerge as a new infrastructure category—opening opportunities for startups building the 'middleware' of the AI stack.
